scope: Direct GPL port of the retained inhabited-land city-mask bake into native game code, with resolved cached startup-only R8 publication to the existing regular/conforming primary terrain shader. No new render pass, settlement/activity model, simulation clock or secondary-ray emission.

contract.ownership: GPL terrain-native owns the retained population/suitability envelope, hash-speckle bake and actual immutable world land gate. MIT graphics owns the shared resolved extent budget. MIT render-wgpu uploads caller R8 data to the already-shared MIT primary terrain shader; no GPL producer is relicensed into the engine.
contract.resolution: Low 128x64 / Medium 256x128 / High 512x256 R8. Disabled, zero or invalid resolved gain returns no extent: no source bake/cache, effect texture or upload, only an existing shared one-texel black binding. Renderer/source recreation reuses the CPU mask if extent and immutable Scene world are unchanged.
contract.lifecycle: One startup bake per extent; one upload per renderer, no per-frame bake/upload or prepass. CPU cache releases on disabled renderer creation. Allocated-unpublished stays dark. Invalid full-mask length is rejected before any texture/uniform mutation.
contract.coordinates: Body-fixed globe UV: east-positive atan2(-z,x), v=0 north; repeat-U/clamp-V filtering includes seam continuity. Regular and conforming primary geometry consume the identical fragment path.
contract.emission: Retained authored warm linear RGB (1,0.72,0.42) * mask * first-slot terminator gate * optical gain * 500, pre-exposure. Not calibrated watts, electrical activity, eclipse-aware or total multi-source illumination. No secondary RT-hit/reflection/indirect emission.
contract.counters: NightLightsStats extent/storage_bytes/uploaded_bytes, actual CLI native_night_lights output and startup region/lit-texel/bake-time log. Existing scene-classify/raster GPU scope includes the texture sample; scope layout unchanged.
